paragraphs: Rav Amram, son of R' Shimon bar Abba.
He spoke in his father’s name in [Shabbat 119b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.119b.9), and in Rabbi Chanina’s name in [Sanhedrin 70a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.70a.16).[^1][^2]

notes.text: In Shabbat, Rav Amram speaks in the name of his father, Rabbi Shimon bar Abba, who speaks in the name of Rabbi Chanina.
In Sanhedrin, Rav Amram is identified as the son of Rabbi Shimon bar Abba and speaks directly in the name of Rabbi Chanina.
